description: Plan a safe dependency upgrade from caller-supplied release facts: the ordered intermediate versions between the current and target versions, the breaking changes carried by each step, and a verdict. Versions and changes are never fetched; every fact is supplied.

current.description: Currently installed version, in x.y.z form

breaking_changes.description: Breaking changes introduced by this release (optional)

target.description: Target version, in x.y.z form; must be greater than current

name: plan_upgrade_path
